job.name: hist_toon_c
job.meaning: рисованный добрый дедушка-летописец: белая борода, льняная рубаха с вышитым воротом и тёмный жилет, деревянная горница со свечами и старыми книгами
job.prompt: A kind old chronicler grandfather about 70 with a white beard and twinkling eyes, a linen shirt with a simple embroidered collar and a dark wool waistcoat. Background: a cosy wooden log-house room with a small window, warm candle light, closed leather-bound old books and a clay jug on a shelf, softly blurred. FRAMING: vertical 9:16, waist-up, both shoulders fully inside the frame, centred, top of head about 14% below the upper edge, face large, looking straight at the viewer, mid-sentence with lips slightly parted as if telling an exciting story, calm friendly expression, NO broad smile, hands relaxed and out of the frame or low. ABSOLUTELY NO text, letters, writing or scribbles anywhere (books are closed or pages blank, no chalkboard), no watermark, no signature.
job.style: Warm painterly storybook digital illustration, like a frame from a modern hand-painted animated film for adults: soft visible brushwork, slightly stylised but believable proportions, expressive friendly eyes, rosy cheeks, warm golden window light, cosy nostalgic atmosphere, rich warm palette of honey, cream, olive green, muted teal and rosewood, soft shadows, fine detail. NOT photorealistic, NOT 3D plastic CGI, NOT anime, NOT flat vector.
job.style_qa: тёплая живописная «сказочная» цифровая иллюстрация, как кадр рисованного мультфильма для взрослых: мягкие мазки, слегка стилизованные, но правдоподобные пропорции, тёплый золотой свет, уютная ностальгическая атмосфера
